technical.zh-CN: WALL-A 页面列出少样本学习、跨任务迁移和强化学习方向；展示线束整理、拉拉链、纸巾更换等柔性物体操作任务，适合按任务而非仅按本体形态检索。
technical.en: The WALL-A page lists few-shot learning, cross-task transfer and reinforcement learning, showing cable organization, zipper operation and tissue replacement. Index these deformable-object tasks separately from body shape.
